title: Sangha Studio
specs: Multiple locations including Pine, North, Williston, and online
Retreat includes community activities, yoga, hiking, and hot tub
No prior yoga experience needed; beginners encouraged in certain classes
Must bring own mat and props for outdoor classes or request in advance
To teach at studio, must attend classes for at least four months prior and commit to teaching 2 classes per week for 8-12 months
Class sizes vary and are currently limited for social distancing
Retreat accommodations include shared bunk rooms and shared rooms with 1-2 others

blurb: Sangha Studio offers donation-based yoga classes in multiple locations and online, aiming to make yoga accessible to all. They provide a variety of class styles including beginner-friendly options and special workshops. The studio also hosts retreats and community events to deepen connection and practice.
extraNote: Classes are donation-based; suggested drop-in donation is $13 · Cancel outdoor class registration at least 2 hours before start to avoid $5 no-show fee · If bad weather, outdoor classes move indoors with 60-minute notice · Membership auto-renews monthly and must be paid by credit or debit card · Class registration can be cancelled via Union.fit account · 120 Main Street, behind NorthStar Sports, at the cross section of Pine Street and Main Street
